supersedes: logs/stages/stage-1/phase_c1/plans/phase_c_roadmap.md, sections 'D2 -- target-aware + reference-confidence weighting' and 'D3 -- target-aware + KL + pure student confidence'. Kept verbatim there as history, with a pointer here.

d1._meaning: D1 declares no scoring objective; its per-item mean of the KL is the historical, KL-only path and its identities are untouched

aggregation_difference_from_d1.depth: none: per item over T_x, items averaged equally within a sub-type, then sub-type and domain -- D1's DEPTH rule
aggregation_difference_from_d1.state_evaluation: none since revision 3: within a sub-type items are weighted by T_x (the integrand pooled over the sub-type's scored positions, divided by their count) and each critical class is pooled over items -- D1's state-KL weighting. The per-item value keeps the fixed 1/T_x. state.objective.raw_kl.* is the raw KL under this same aggregation and equals D1's state.teacher_kl.* and state.critical_token_kl

scientific_motivation.title: capacity-aware student reasoning
scientific_motivation.premise: The teacher (Qwen3-4B-Thinking) and the ~0.6B student differ in capacity, expressiveness and learning ability. The student need not, and may not be able to, reproduce the teacher's reasoning distribution; on some tasks it may reach the same correct answer by a shorter, simpler or entirely different trajectory.
scientific_motivation.consequence: A large teacher token-level KL does not by itself mean worse student reasoning. KL-based compression selection may over-reward structures that imitate the teacher's distribution and under-rate structures that preserve the student's own effective way of reasoning.
scientific_motivation.question: Which structural initialization, under the capacity limit, best lets the student keep and recover its own effective reasoning ability?
scientific_motivation.role_of_confidence: the student's Top-K confidence is a CANDIDATE PROXY signal for structure selection. Its value is decided by independent behavioural evidence, never assumed

d2.formula: L(x) = (1/T_x) sum_{t in T_x} (1 - c_t) KL_t, minimized
d2.hypothesis: The more certain the student is of its own prediction at a position, the weaker the KL penalty for differing from the teacher there should be. This does NOT assume the student is right where it is confident; it tests whether relaxing strict imitation of the teacher's distribution helps a small model keep computation and reasoning suited to its own capacity.

d3.formula: L(x) = (1/T_x) sum_{t in T_x} [KL_t - lambda c_t], minimized (S = -L maximized)
d3.hypothesis: The student's own predictive certainty may carry structural-selection value independent of the teacher KL: even where its token distribution differs from the teacher's, a student that is certain of its own distribution earns a separate confidence reward. Whether that signal is useful is decided by task correctness after recovery training, not by the reward.

lambda_rule.statistic: per-item means over each item's scored positions (1/T_x)
lambda_rule.pooling: every UNIQUE item of the three item sets once, unweighted, unique by content identity (sha256 of the token ids). The three sets hold 209 draws but 147 unique items: reasoning_heavy@v2's 62 draws are 51 unique items, all of them also in domain_balanced@v1, which sampled with replacement from the same pool. Counting a repeated draw twice would weight it twice. The with-duplicates value and each set alone are reported as sensitivity, never chosen
lambda_rule.when: ONCE, BEFORE D2's formal search -- not before D3 -- and never revised by any D2 or D3 search or behavioural result

reference.student_model: the standing incumbent B, artifact 53e30566c5f795f1870d76c1fa6a970ddc507fa5459047f3010ffab8aa890342, rebuilt by stages.phase_c2.baseline.frozen_baseline_spec
reference.entropy: the student's own Top-200 conditional entropy

lambda_rule.why_this_scale: lambda converts confidence into KL units. Equating the two components' between-item spread on a reference pair means neither dominates the ranking by scale alone: one inter-quartile range of confidence is worth one inter-quartile range of KL. The IQR rather than the SD because per-item KL is heavy-tailed and the SD would let a few items set the trade-off.
lambda_rule.why_this_reference: a pair NO D-series search produced: the teacher every search starts from and the incumbent every candidate is compared with, at the geometry every search ends at. Measured before D2's search starts and never revised: a lambda chosen after seeing D2 or D3 search or behavioural results would be a selection on outcomes.

diagnostic_threshold_rule.source: the same B-vs-teacher reference calibration as lambda, over the scored positions of the 147 unique items, measured before D2's formal search

thresholds.high_kl: p90 of per-position Top-200 + tail KL (teacher || B)
thresholds.high_confidence: p90 of B's per-position Top-200 confidence
thresholds.low_topk_mass: p10 of B's per-position Top-200 mass

flags.high_confidence_high_kl: confident AND far from the teacher: alternative reasoning or overconfidence, told apart only by correctness
flags.high_confidence_low_topk_mass: a confident Top-200 that holds little of the student's real probability
flags.high_raw_kl: raw KL at or above high_kl, recorded, never acted on

application.depth_candidates_and_states: from the recorded joint histograms; a 'high' threshold is applied at the first grid edge at or above it and a 'low' one at the last edge at or below it, so a flag never counts a position the exact threshold would not

never: enters a score, ranking, pruning or retention
triggers a manual intervention in a running search
is set or revised after D2/D3 candidate results exist

acts_directly_on: global state evaluation of every child
does_not_act_on: FFN, residual WIDTH and ATTENTION operator-local selection: they keep D1's target-aware activation statistic unchanged; their children are reached by the objective only through state evaluation and the beam
objective_scope.do_not_claim: that the local rules of all four operators use student confidence
objective_scope.intermediate_vs_final_student: the confidence the search reads belongs to INTERMEDIATE candidates -- the parent with some layers bypassed in DEPTH, partially compressed children in state evaluation -- before any recovery training. It is not the confidence of the final ~0.6B student after recovery, and it is not evidence about that model's capacity adaptation; only the behavioural evaluation after recovery speaks to that

where_each_objective_applies.depth.causal_kl_greedy_v1: OPERATOR-LOCAL, exactly: the candidate is the parent with S bypassed, and its KL against the parent and its own Top-K entropy come from the same forward
where_each_objective_applies.ffn / residual_width / attention activat: NOT operator-local. Their selection reads parent activation statistics and no candidate exists until it is made, so there is no candidate KL or confidence to weight. They keep D1's target-aware statistic, and their state ids do not fork. The objective reaches their children through state evaluation and the beam
where_each_objective_applies.state evaluation: every child, against the original teacher; the student is the child itself

diagnostics_recorded: D1's KL metrics, unchanged, beside them
d2_degeneracy_watch: a candidate can lower D2's objective by becoming more confident at high-KL positions. D2's ranking never sees raw KL, so raw KL, confidence, Top-K mass and the weight distribution are recorded on every candidate and state, and a low D2 score is never read as higher fidelity. High raw KL is a registered DIAGNOSTIC FLAG (diagnostic_threshold_rule), never an elimination criterion and never a manual intervention

aggregation_control.issue: revision 2 averaged state-evaluation items EQUALLY, where D1's KL-only state metrics weight items by scored positions within a sub-type and pool critical classes over items. That changed length weighting as well as the integrand, so a D1-vs-D2 ranking change could not be attributed to confidence
aggregation_control.resolution: each consumer keeps its KL-only path's weighting (objective identity field `aggregation`, kl_path_weighting_per_consumer/v2): DEPTH averages items equally, as D1's DEPTH did; state evaluation weights items by T_x and pools critical classes. The per-item formula keeps the fixed 1/T_x and never divides by a sum of confidence weights
aggregation_control.built_in_kl_only_control: every objective evaluation also reports state.objective.raw_kl.* -- the raw KL aggregated exactly as the objective is -- which equals D1's state.teacher_kl.* and state.critical_token_kl in the same evaluation (tested to 1e-6). Rankings by raw_kl and by the objective on the same states isolate the effect of the integrand

rollout_rescoring_integration.token_ids: use the generation engine's exact ids, kept by the read-only sidecar wrapper scripts/shared/evaluation/uncapped_eval_token_ids.py. It runs the UNCHANGED in-tree generator (same argv, interpreter and environment) with a hook on the one post-wave decode per record, after the engine loop, so the generation source set, the generation fingerprint and the shared protocol's evaluation identity are the plain run's -- tested on the real generator with a stub engine: identical records, summaries and reconstructed fingerprint. The hook installs only when the generator's source digest equals the protocol's; every row is verified against its record (id count, prompt count, decoded-text sha256, EOS vs stop_reason) and the sidecar header says whether the stratum is exact. A record with no exact row is rescored from retokenized text, ids_source=retokenized_text, labelled approximate per sample. Recording ids inside the generator itself remains a VERSIONED decision (d_series_shared_eval v2), not taken

token_ids_identity.changes: only the behavioural driver's own executable closure, because its argv names the wrapper -- correct for reproducibility, and not part of the generation identity
token_ids_identity.not_in_generation_source_set: the wrapper is deliberately NOT added to source_sets.json generation.files: adding it would move the source digest it exists to preserve
token_ids_identity.residual: engine scheduling is timing-dependent in the plain run too; the wrapper adds no work inside the engine loop, so it changes no code path the tokens depend on, but token equality with a counterfactual plain run cannot be proven on a non-batch-invariant engine

alignment_evidence: count and decoded-text match with the record
untouched: the shared protocol's scoring contract and endpoint
rollout_rescoring_integration.checkpoint_release: only after the diagnostic evidence is persisted durably, when a consumer exists
rollout_rescoring_integration.failure_isolation: a rescoring failure is recorded per sample and never alters or blocks a completed per-sample score (rollout_rescoring.rescore_unit)
rollout_rescoring_integration.cost: MEASURE before pricing: the reference calibration session times the rescoring on the real teacher and B over sequences of D1's measured lengths; the behavioural ceiling includes it only after that measurement. The 3-5 min/probe figure is an estimate, not a bound
rollout_rescoring_integration.historical_units: no logits, confidence or student-side quantity is computed or estimated for B or q2

independence: D3's definition, K and lambda rule are fixed in this record before D2 runs; no D2 behavioural or search result may adjust them

measurement_distinctions.student_entropy_on_teacher_native_prefix: what the D2/D3 search objectives use: the student's own Top-K entropy on the frozen teacher-native calibration and state-eval sequences
measurement_distinctions.student_entropy_on_student_rollout_prefi: a behavioural DIAGNOSTIC only: the student's own Top-K entropy at the positions of its own greedy rollout, by scripts/shared/evaluation/rollout_rescoring.py after generation. Never an input to selection in D2/D3
measurement_distinctions.student_teacher_distribution_fit: the Top-K + tail KL: on teacher-native prefixes in the search; on the student's own prefixes in the rollout diagnostic, beside the teacher's surprisal of the student's tokens
measurement_distinctions.autonomous_rollout_correctness: the primary behavioural endpoint, correct_overall on the shared protocol, after the frozen recovery recipe. The only quantity a D2/D3 promotion question is decided on

calibration_this_round: the frozen TEACHER-NATIVE calibration profiles, unchanged, so the objective is the only variable. No student-prefix calibration is introduced in D2 or D3

instruments.rollout_profile: scripts/stages/stage-1/families/d_series/rollout_profile.py -- text-level, $0, from secured generations: generated length (engine count), reasoning/answer length, natural termination, degeneration, correctness by reasoning length, and paired same-prompt comparisons
instruments.rollout_rescoring: scripts/shared/evaluation/rollout_rescoring.py -- per position of the student's own rollout: student confidence, student token log-prob, teacher surprisal, KL(teacher || student). Needs the trained checkpoint, so it runs ON THE POD after generation and before the checkpoint is released. Reads generations; changes neither generation nor scoring, so the shared evaluation protocol's identity is untouched. Estimated 3-5 GPU-minutes per probe (~0.95M tokens per probe at D1's measured lengths)

analyses.question: does the student still solve the task when it is far from the teacher's distribution?
analyses.instrument: rollout_rescoring (per sample: mean KL and teacher surprisal on its own rollout) joined to correctness

analyses.question: autonomous reasoning length, correctness and usable rollout
analyses.arms: every unit, including the imported B/q2 (baseline recorded in analyses/d1_rollout_profile.json)

analyses.question: how does student confidence relate to actual correctness?
analyses.instrument: rollout_rescoring confidence (reasoning and answer spans) against per-sample correctness

analyses.question: are high-confidence, high-KL positions valid alternative reasoning or wrong overconfidence?
analyses.instrument: rollout_rescoring quadrant fraction against correctness; thresholds registered in each experiment's preregistration before any result, none in code

analyses.question: did D2/D3 improve autonomous generation after recovery, not only the search objective?
analyses.instrument: the shared-protocol endpoint and the rollout profile against B (and q2), read beside each candidate's search objective and raw KL
analyses.arms: candidates vs the imported B/q2 units

behavioural_diagnostics.historical_units: B's and q2's ten units have decoded text and the engine's token counts, but NO token ids, log-probabilities or logits, and their checkpoints are retired. Their student confidence on their own rollouts is therefore NOT available and must not be estimated or inferred; comparisons with B/q2 are text-level and endpoint-level only. Re-tokenizing their text reproduces the engine's count exactly for 82-85% of samples
behavioural_diagnostics.power_note: D1's units answer ~2-4% of scorable prompts correctly (B: 103 of 2550 on confirmation), and q2 and B are both right on only 29 prompt-seeds there. Any confidence-correctness or quadrant analysis rests on ~100 correct samples per arm and is exploratory

claim_boundary.goal: structural initializations that, under the capacity limit, help the student keep and recover its own effective reasoning
may_claim: a D2/D3 candidate's endpoint result against B on the shared protocol, with that protocol's limits (SHARED_GO nominates, never promotes)
descriptive rollout and rescoring diagnostics of the candidates that were actually measured, labelled exploratory
may_not_claim: that a lower D2/D3 search objective means better reasoning or higher fidelity
that the student reasons differently, or better, where it is confident and far from the teacher, without rollout-level evidence linking those positions to correct completions
any confidence or per-position statement about B or q2, whose checkpoints are retired and whose generations carry no log-probabilities
a mechanism from the exploratory diagnostics alone
that the local selection rules of all four operators use student confidence (only DEPTH's does; see objective_scope)
that confidence read on intermediate search candidates describes the final recovered student's capacity adaptation

that the family-wise bound across D1-D3 is an unconditional guarantee: it is a nominal accounting bound, conditional on each test's nominal level, which adaptive reuse of the observed confirmation data can violate
claim_boundary.validation: Top-K confidence is a proxy for structure selection; its usefulness is established only by independent behavioural evidence after recovery training
